Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering by giving a model a real GitHub issue plus a repository snapshot and asking it to produce a patch that makes the associated tests pass. The Verified subset focuses on tasks that have been manually validated as solvable and reliably testable, emphasizing end-to-end bug fixing over isolated coding puzzles.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Attention (minor)
L3: Self-reflection (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends the SWE-bench style of repository-level bug fixing to multiple programming languages, testing whether models can transfer software engineering competence beyond Python. Tasks still require producing patches that satisfy project-specific tests, but with varied ecosystems, tooling conventions, and language semantics.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility, Self-reflection (minor)
